title: A Markov stabilization preserves the unknot closure
statement: The trivial braid $e\in B_1$ closes to the unknot, and both stabilizations $e\sigma_1$ and $e\sigma_1^{-1}$ in $B_2$ also close to the unknot; the explicit isotopies are the R1 unwinding of the added kink, one for each sign.
strategy: Compute the closures: the one-strand trivial braid closes to a circle about the axis; adding a strand with one crossing adds a kink on the new strand near the axis, and the kink is pulled straight by the first Reidemeister isotopy. Both signs occur, matching the two signs of stabilization.

references.title: Birman and Brendle, Braids: A Survey, Handbook of Knot Theory chapter, author manuscript; section 2 (printed pp. 12-26) and Figures 3-12
